Manage background guest jobs.

```text
pomme jobs SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme jobs list

List background jobs.

```text
pomme jobs list [NAME] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme jobs inspect

Inspect a background job.

```text
pomme jobs inspect [NAME] JOB_ID [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |
| `JOB_ID` | Background job ID, as printed by `pomme exec --detach` or `pomme jobs list`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme jobs logs

Print background job output.

```text
pomme jobs logs [NAME] JOB_ID [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |
| `JOB_ID` | Background job ID, as printed by `pomme exec --detach` or `pomme jobs list`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme jobs wait

Wait for a background job.

```text
pomme jobs wait [NAME] JOB_ID [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |
| `JOB_ID` | Background job ID, as printed by `pomme exec --detach` or `pomme jobs list`. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme jobs kill

Signal a background job.

```text
pomme jobs kill [NAME] JOB_ID [--signal SIGNAL] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |
| `JOB_ID` | Background job ID, as printed by `pomme exec --detach` or `pomme jobs list`. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--signal SIGNAL` | Signal: TERM, KILL, INT, or HUP. Default: `TERM`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
